items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 3:36 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 3:37 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a litigation or potential litigation, information that belongs to the municipality and labour relations matter, a further labour relations matter and a land acquisition and disposition matter as authorized by Sections 239 (d) (e) and (j)) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
